56c9a83c490473c6f82c669f2d8f37a66c89ba2a:
query FlxDonateDashboard($range: FlxDonationRange, $from: String, $to: String) {
  flxDonationDashboard(range: $range, from: $from, to: $to) {
    from
    to
    fromLabel
    toLabel
    currency
    symbol
    hasAny
    allDonors
    now {
      total
      gifts
      donors
      newDonors
      average
    }
    prev {
      total
      gifts
      donors
      newDonors
      average
    }
    mrr
    activeSubscriptions
    pastDueSubscriptions
    series {
      day
      label
      oneTime
      recurring
      gifts
    }
    oneTime {
      amount
      gifts
    }
    recurring {
      amount
      gifts
    }
    byType {
      id
      label
      amount
      gifts
    }
    byForm {
      id
      label
      amount
      gifts
    }
    topDonors {
      id
      name
      contact
      amount
      gifts
      url
    }
    canList
    csvUrl
    listUrl
    donorsUrl
    importUrl
    ownOnly
  }
}
b1c69af704b64d32eb4c0e0e8ae768402018b538:
query FlxDonateDonor($id: Int!) {
  flxDonor(id: $id) {
    databaseId
    name
    initial
    email
    phone
    phoneLabel
    sinceLabel
    totalLabel
    giftCount
    averageLabel
    lastGiftLabel
    ownOnly
    gifts {
      databaseId
      donorId
      donorName
      contact
      amountLabel
      kind
      statusLabel
      tone
      date {
        label
      }
      where
      lines
      referral
      referralFromDonor
      code
      url
    }
    giftsTotal
    giftsUrl
    subscriptions {
      databaseId
      donorId
      donorName
      donorUrl
      reference
      amountLabel
      intervalLabel
      status
      statusLabel
      tone
      note
      startedLabel
      nextLabel
      gifts
      giftsUrl
      canCancel
    }
    certificatesOn
    certificates {
      number
      dateLabel
      url
    }
    moreCertificates
    consentKvkk
    consentEmail
    consentSms
    note
    canEdit
    canAdd
    addUrl
    listUrl
  }
}
